title: Father's cylindrical UFO sighting

tellings.quote: he said he saw a UFO uh, one time over um, central California. wild as a cylindrical UFO with a red light on the front he said

plain: A cylinder-shaped UFO with a red light on its front was once seen over central California, according to the father of Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants. Colbern tells it second-hand, as something his father told him he saw one time.
